description: Get new job matches based on a saved job hunt configuration. Uses the filters saved in your job hunt (titles, locations, skills, salary, etc.) and only returns jobs you have not already seen, applied to, or rejected. To change filters, use update_job_hunt first.

jobHuntId.description: The job hunt ID to match jobs against

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default: 5, max: 50). Keep low to avoid large responses.

name: match_jobs
